messages:
sanjay: Heads-up — I'm drafting a focused runbook update for the AZ12 bring-up. Goal: add a capacity-gating section, a compact preflight checklist, and a 'known issues' appendix. Will open a PR in ~30m.
helene: nice, please include the kernel panic observation (nv-hostengine) from yesterday. we had 2 nodes fail during driver install. :warning:
sanjay: noted. thinking of a short triage flow + exact `dmesg` grep to attach.
mike: request: add a quota gating step so we don't start provisioning after we hit soft GPU quotas. a single failed allocation should auto-stop the playbook.
rachel: Also add a cost-estimate step for Dedicated buckets — run the cheap check that flags >10% oversubscription vs expected demand.
sanjay: agree. proposed gating sequence: (1) region capacity query, (2) quota check, (3) AMI/driver sanity, (4) network e2e ping, (5) smoke-run. keep each step <2 commands.
devex-cora: for dev onboarding, can you keep an inline example of `redwoodctl` commands? new engs copy-paste a lot. :+1:
sanjay: will do. preliminary preflight snippet I'm planning to include:```bash
# AZ12 preflight (example)
# 1) quota check
gcloud compute regions describe us-west-az12 --format="yaml(quotas)"
# 2) attempt dry-alloc (no commit)
./scripts/dry-alloc --region us-west-az12 --gpu-type a100 --count 4
# 3) driver sanity on reference image
ssh bootstrap-01 'sudo dmesg | tail -n 200 | grep -i nvrm || true'
# 4) network probe to control-plane
curl -sS https://controlplane.redwood.internal/health || echo "network-fail"
```
helene: for the driver panic link the journal lines. example patch: `journalctl -u nvidia-driver.service -b | grep -i "nvrm: Xid"` helps find Xid codes. add guidance to collect logs: `sudo tar -czf /tmp/az12-diagnostics.tgz /var/log/journal /var/log/nvidia*`
mike: add automatic rollback note: if preflight dry-alloc fails more than 3x in 15m, abort and escalate to infra-oncall. Also mention cost control: if dry-alloc suggests 20% or more extra vGPU usage vs expected, put a cap.
sanjay: good. question for @devex-cora — any small wording changes to make this friendly for product infra folks? I want it concise but readable.
devex-cora: keep the 'What to expect' bullets at top and a TL;DR box for slack handoff. Example TL;DR: "bootstrap started, expect 30-45m, blockers: quotas/driver/Xid". Also add a template on the handoff message to post in #eng-infra.
rachel: Can we add a 'cost ticket' template? ops finance asks for RU (reserved units) delta and projected monthly run cost. small table is fine.
sanjay: I'll add a stub. quick example I plan to paste in runbook:```text
Cost snapshot (estimate):
- baseline: 200 RU
- bring-up peak: +48 RU (~24% increase)
- projected monthly delta: $6,200
Action: open cost ticket with finance if >20% or >$5k delta
```
helene: Known issues appendix: include two entries: 1) driver Xid causing node reboot; 2) MTU mismatch causing kubelet flaps on ENIs. add quick fixes for both.
mike: For MTU: add `ip link set dev eth0 mtu 8950` example and mention why 9000 sometimes fails in our cloud image.
sanjay: I'll also add troubleshooting flow: "node not joining cluster" -> check control-plane cert, control-plane reverse DNS, kubelet logs, and then `journalctl -u cloud-init`.
ops-bot: Reminder: new runbook docs must follow docblock template and include an owner + pager.
devex-cora: can you assign owner to infra-distro? then we can add doc review step with devex + security.
sanjay: assigning to infra-distro. will open PR in ~25m and ping reviewers. please react with :eyes: if you can review within 4 hours.\mike: :eyes: will look after standup.
helene: :thumbsup: I'll test the preflight snippet on a spare AZ tomorrow and post results.
ops-bot: Ticket CREATED: DOC-4387 (Runbook - AZ12: capacity gating + known issues). Link: https://tickets.internal/DOC-4387
sanjay: thanks. will paste PR link here when ready.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: runbook PR merged by sanjay — commit 6f3b9a3. CI: docs-lint passed.
